I am looking for RPC handlers that transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs. This likely connects to the webhook logic identified earlier.

The convergence function is likely `webhook.Post` or `PostAsync`. I will search the codebase to identify the exact handler methods.
I'll trace RPC handlers that can trigger outbound HTTP to a user-configured URL, and find where those paths converge.
Tracing `webhook.PostAsync` back to its callers in `memo_service_webhooks.go` to identify the RPC handlers involved.

I am tracing RPC handlers that transitively invoke DispatchMemo*Webhook. The dispatch functions themselves are not RPC handlers.

Candidate RPC handlers include CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, and CreateMemoComment. I am also checking whether other outbound HTTP paths—such as identity provider URLs, S3, or link preview fetchers—qualify under the user-configured URL definition.

The convergence point is `webhook.PostAsync`. Memo-created, updated, and deleted webhooks flow through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` into `PostAsync`. Comment-created webhooks call `PostAsync` directly. `PostAsync` queues the request; `Post` performs the actual delivery.

The convergence function is `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. It is the last shared function before async delivery. `webhook.Post` performs the actual delivery.

I will now search for every RPC handler that transitively invokes a DispatchMemo* webhook.
Checking callers of `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` and `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` to identify all outbound HTTP paths. `CreateMemoComment` may also trigger webhooks.

I am tracing all callers of `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` to identify which RPC handlers trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-configured URLs. Other RPCs such as `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`, and `UpsertMemoReaction` may also cause updated webhooks.
Planning to use recursive grep to trace outbound HTTP requests through RPC handlers.

CreateMemo triggers outbound HTTP via DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook. UpdateMemo triggers it via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. DeleteMemo triggers it via DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook. The fourth handler was not yet identified.

CreateMemoComment also triggers outbound HTTP through DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook. SetMemoAttachments and SetMemoRelations both route through dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects. UpsertMemoReaction and DeleteMemoReaction were not found in the dispatch search. Other potential paths such as SSO sign-in and email settings were considered but appear unrelated to user-configured webhook URLs.

The convergence point is PostAsync. CreateMemo routes through DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook and dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook to reach it. Link preview fetchers and AI service endpoints were ruled out as unrelated to user-configured webhook URLs.

CreateMemoComment reaches PostAsync directly without dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook. All paths converge at webhook.PostAsync. The comment path would be missed if only dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook were named as the convergence function.

PostAsync is the single function where all outbound webhook paths converge before delivery. CreateMemoComment transitively reaches it through CreateMemo, so the full set of six handlers is CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations.
fetchHTMLMeta in memo_service.go may trigger outbound HTTP requests to user-provided URLs via link previews.

GetLinkMetadata and BatchGetLinkMetadata also make outbound HTTP requests to user-provided URLs.

Those handlers converge on fetchHTMLMeta or httpgetter.GetHTMLMeta, not webhook.PostAsync. The phrase "user-configured URL" likely refers to stored webhook URLs rather than request-time metadata URLs. If both webhook and link-metadata paths are included, they do not converge on a single function. SSO sign-in follows a separate OAuth2 path.

The memo mutation RPCs converge on PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go. At least three handlers are CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, and DeleteMemo. CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations also transitively trigger outbound requests through these paths.

PostAsync is the convergence function. It is the last hop before the worker calls Post for actual delivery.

SignIn triggers outbound HTTP via SSO through the oauth2 path, separate from webhook.

Webhook RPC handlers converge at PostAsync in internal/webhook/webhook.go. These include CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, and SetMemoRelations.

CreateMemo, UpdateMemo, DeleteMemo, CreateMemoComment, SetMemoAttachments, SetMemoRelations; PostAsync — internal/webhook/webhook.go

Those memo RPCs dispatch user webhook URLs (`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` / `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` / `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` / `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`, called from `memo_service.go`, `memo_service_comments.go`, `memo_attachment_service.go`, `memo_relation_service.go`). Create/update/delete go through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`; the comment event posts directly. Every payload is handed to `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` before the workers call `Post`.
